title: When the Room Breaks
author: Theo Winterbourne
blurb: Ada Ashgrove, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
